sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge
 Order

1. Through the medium of instant petition, the petitioner seeks the following reliefs:-
"WRIT OF MANDAMUS (i) Commanding upon the respondents to grant compensation under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the land measuring 2  kanals falling under Khasra No. 298 situated at Village Noonabandi, Tehsil Haveli, District Poonch Mohd. Bashir vs Ut Of J&K Through ... on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36376500/
1 acquired by the respondents for construction of road from "Noonabandi Nari to Dhanna" from the above said land of petitioner without adopting due process of law.
(ii) Further commanding the respondents to grant compensation to the petitioner for causing damage to the triple storey house of the petitioner falling under Khasra No.
298 situated at Village Noonabandi, Tehsil Haveli, District Poonch due to the construction of the above said land."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner's father is owner in cultivating possession of the land falling under Khasra No. 298 situated at Village Noonabandi, Tehsil Haveli,
District Poonch being his proprietary land.

It is pertinent to mention here that the above said land was divided amongst three brothers including the petitioner herein and the land whereupon the road has been constructed, falls within the share of the petitioner.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the respondents without any intimation/adopting due course of law have constructed road "Noonabandi Nari to Dhanna" from the land of the petitioner.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that due to the aforesaid construction of the road from the land of the petitioner, the triple storied house of the petitioner has suffered extensive damage and cracks have appeared in the house of the petitioner due to the construction of the aforesaid road due to which the petitioner has suffered huge financial loss which cannot be compensated by any means thereafter, as the said land is the only source of livelihood for the petitioner and his family members as they were totally dependent on the same.
5.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner moved a representation to the respondent No. 4 for the grant of compensation and the respondent No. 4 forwarded the same to the respondent No. 5 for necessary action under rules on 02.08.2023, but till date nothing has been done.
Feeling aggrieved of what has been stated above, the petitioner has approached this Court by way of instant writ petition.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner would feel satisfied, if the instant writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondents to treat the instant writ petition as representation and accord consideration to the same within some reasonable period.
Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG waives notice on behalf of the officials respondents.

He submits that the respondents have no objection, if the instant writ petition is directed to be treated as representation and same is accorded consideration strictly in accordance with the rules and as per law.

9. With the consent of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case, the instant writ petition is disposed of, at the threshold, with a direction Mohd. Bashir vs Ut Of J&K Through ... on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36376500/
2 to the respondents to consider the claim of the petitioner by treating this writ petition as representation and take a decision thereon, strictly under rules and as per law and pass a consideration order within a period of six weeks from the date a certified copy of this order alongwith complete set of writ petition are made available to the respondents.
